_doc: Role of every converter. sft = has verified reasoning, may be trained directly (still run render_chat.py --require-think). prompt_only = use prompt + gold; regenerate answers (student first, teacher for failures) and keep only verified ones. dpo = chosen/rejected pairs. style = has thinking but no answer verifier (use a small slice). needs = extra assets. render = flags for tools/render_chat.py (always add --tokenizer ... --max-tokens 16384). exclude = do not use as-is (reason in note); converter kept for reference.

allenai__tmax-sft.note: 118/450 assistant turns have empty reasoning (30 full rows): --require-think keeps 10/33 samples, --mask-nothink keeps 30 (301 trained turns, empty-think turns stay as context with no loss)

zjunlp__DataMind-12K.note: train split only. Raw text-tag protocol (<code>/<interpreter> as user turns) is converted to native tool calls execute_python(code) by default (NATIVE_TOOLS=1)

open-athena__e2egit-large-qwen3.5-122b-3.note: reuse for siblings with SRC=open-athena/<repo> ONLY after checking first user turn == instruction (true for 32k Terminus traces, false for 131k opencode traces); Terminus-2 JSON-keystroke text protocol (not native tool calls), env output arrives as user turns so each step becomes its own sample -> keep it a small share

open-athena__nemotron-code-oracle-filter.note: AUDIT: task prompt missing in every row (first user turn empty; `instruction` is the model's final answer, NOT the task) -> converter skips all rows unless TASK_PROMPTS join is provided; ~52% of turns have no <think>; traces up to 131k. Use the 32k-trace siblings instead

nvidia__Open-SWE-Traces__v1.2-minisweage.note: set TEACHERS=qwen38_27b. AUDIT: 0/17 resolved trajectories in 30 rows fit 16K tokens (rendered 16.8K-120K) -> near-zero yield at 16K; useful only for a 32K+ run or by scanning many shards for short ones

rl-research__dr-tulu-sft-data.note: drops popqa_tydiqa/browsecomp/wikipedia questions; teacher not Qwen (format differs)

HuggingFaceTB__smoltalk2__systemchats_th.note: short-thinking anchors for easy chat; small slice only

wannaphong__thai-magpie-qwen3-think.note: Thai thinking style; small slice only

thavens__Qwen3-14B-secalign-tools.note: chosen has no thinking -> regenerate chosen with student/teacher for SFT; hint sentence stripped

nvidia__When2Call.note: train_sft has NO tool-call rows (7,890 no_tool_call / 7,110 request_for_info) -> mix with positive tool-call data; never use test/ (BFCL-derived)

MadeAgents__xlam-irrelevance-7.5k.note: 6 rows match BFCL -> run contamination.py filter

ThaiLLM__med-tool-use.verifier: first call name == expected_tool / no call

typhoon-ai__typhoon-s-instruct-post-trai.verifier: tool rows: target_tools; AutoIF: no machine-readable kwargs (LLM judge)

agentica-org__DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset.note: 93 rows identical to MMLU-Pro test -> contamination.py filter; contains past AIME/AMC

KodCode__KodCode-V1.note: MAX_SIM filter; Light-RL-10K has no benchmark_similarity -> use contamination.py

nvidia__Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Indirect-Pro.verifier: forbidden tool not called AND required_tools called (completion check still TODO)

artefactory__ledger-long-context-KPI-QA.note: AUDIT (30 full rows): every report ~215K chars (>>16K tokens) -> 0 rows fit; qrels incomplete (9/30 rows empty; answer pages not listed) so qrel windowing fails; gold from yfinance, not from the report (unit/definition mismatch risk). Revisit only for a 64K+ long-context run

DuckerMaster__Thai-Synth-Receipts.needs: images; image field format still to confirm with team
